note: Index of the per-collection navigation files, each an RWPM subset (Readium Web Publication Manifest: metadata + links + readingOrder + toc). This index itself is not RWPM (RWPM has no list-of-publications concept). Consumed by fulltoc.html (which collections to render, in order) and booknav.js (map a page path -> its collection via `prefixes`; longest match wins; `fallback` catches unmatched /zf_info pages). Hand-maintained. The final `everything-else` collection is a catch-all listing every .html file in the repo that no other collection lists (including /ZFIN pages); it has no prefixes and is not the fallback, so booknav.js never selects it, and its empty readingOrder means fulltoc.html counts its toc entries instead.
